info.title: BevShop API
info.description: Single-owner beverage shop API. Use auth/setup once, or auth/login, then copy the returned token into Authorize (without the Bearer prefix). Request IDs must reference existing records. Dates use RFC3339 timestamps with an explicit timezone. This document describes the currently implemented routes.

post.description: Creates the single owner and returns an access token. Returns 409 if an owner already exists.
